items.name: core
items.title: Core
items.description: cn(), the tone classes, the palette generator, theme.css (Tailwind theme) and tokens.css (the design's values). Every item needs it.

items.name: basics
items.title: Accordion, Kbd, AvatarGroup, RelativeTime, Banner, Stepper
items.description: Sections that open one at a time or together: settings groups, details, help.

items.name: button
items.title: Button, ButtonGroup, SplitButton, ToggleButton, CopyButton
items.description: A button. Verb first, sentence case: "Save changes", "Add customer".

items.name: chat
items.title: Conversation, Message, Thinking, StreamCaret, MessageActions, Attachment, Suggestions, PromptInput, Confirmation, Questionnaire, VariantChooser, ModelSelector, ContextMeter
items.description:
The scrolling list of messages. It stays at the bottom while replies stream
in, unless they've scrolled up to read; then a "Latest" button takes them back.

items.name: choices
items.title: Checkbox, Switch
items.description: On or off for one thing, or one of several in a list. Takes effect when the form is saved; for an instant setting use Switch.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description:
Pick one from a long list by typing: a customer, a country, a product.
For under about 12 choices, Select is simpler.

items.name: command
items.title: CommandPalette
items.description:
Search and jump anywhere from the keyboard: screens, records, actions.
Opens with ⌘K or Ctrl K (useCommandKey) or from a search button. Arrow keys
move, Enter runs, Escape closes.

items.name: data
items.title: Pagination, FilterBar, Timeline, BarChart, LineChart
items.description: Moves through a long list a page at a time, under a Table.

items.name: datepicker
items.title: Calendar, DatePicker
items.description: A month to pick a day from. DatePicker opens one from a field; use it alone for a booking screen.

items.name: daterange
items.title: DateRangePicker, RangeCalendar
items.description: A field for a period (a report's dates, a filter): presets, two months to pick on, and Apply.

items.name: dev
items.title: CodeBlock, Terminal, StackTrace, TestResults, FileTree
items.description: Code to read and copy, with its file name or language and a Copy button.

items.name: display
items.title: Badge, Avatar, Card, StatCard, EmptyState, Skeleton, Progress
items.description: One or two words of status. The same status gets the same tone on every screen.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, a control, and its hint or error, wired together for screen readers.

items.name: fields-more
items.title: TagInput, NumberInput, CurrencyInput, InlineEdit, KeyValueEditor, ApiKeyField, Slider
items.description:
Several values in one field: emails to invite, tags, recipients. Enter,
comma or Tab adds what's typed; pasting a list adds them all; Backspace
in an empty field removes the last.

items.name: focus
items.title: focus
items.description: Shared code the components use (focus.ts).

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: The top of a landing page: what it is, why it matters, and the one thing to do next.

items.name: icons
items.title: icons
items.description: Shared code the components use (icons.tsx).

items.name: inputs
items.title: Input, Textarea, Select
items.description:
A one-line text field, in fifteen looks, with the extras forms need: a clear
button, a counter, a copy button, add-ons, an inline action. Put it in a Field
for its label, hint and error (or use floating, notched or inline, which draw
the label inside). A password field has a button that shows what was typed.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A short list of actions on one thing: a row's Edit, Duplicate, Delete; the account's Settings, Sign out. Arrow keys move, Escape closes.

items.name: overlays
items.title: Dialog, Alert
items.description: A task that needs the whole of someone's attention: a short form, or a confirmation. Focus stays inside until it closes.

items.name: palette-style
items.title: PaletteStyle
items.description:
Applies a palette, light and dark, as a <style> tag: put it in the root
layout. One of preset, seed or palette; the neutral palette if none.

items.name: panel
items.title: SidePanel, DetailList
items.description:
One row's details, opened beside its list so people keep their place:
an order from the orders table, a customer from customers. Focus stays
inside until it closes.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover, Tooltip
items.description:
Content that opens from a button and stays until you click away or press
Escape: a short form, filters, a picker. For actions, use Menu; for a hint,
Tooltip; for a task that needs full attention, Dialog.

items.name: pricing
items.title: PricingTable
items.description: Two to four plans, the recommended one marked, with a monthly/yearly switch; 21 looks.

items.name: selection
items.title: RadioGroup, SegmentedControl
items.description: One of a few choices, all on show: a plan, a delivery speed, who can see something. For many choices, Select.

items.name: shell
items.title: AppShell, Sidebar, NavSection, NavItem, Topbar, Breadcrumbs, PageCrumbs
items.description:
The frame of an app's signed-in screens: a sidebar on the left, a top bar,
and the screen. It fills the window (or its className's height) and the
screen scrolls inside it, so the sidebar always fits. From 768px wide the
sidebar stays on show; narrower, it slides in from the Topbar's menu button
and closes when a link is picked. Those widths are the shell's own (container
queries), so it fits a box as well as the window; its main area is a
container too, for screens laid out with

items.name: shop
items.title: ProductCard, PriceTag, Rating, QuantityStepper, CartSummary
items.description: A product in a grid: photo, name, price and, when asked, a button to add it to the cart.

items.name: sidenav
items.title: SideNav
items.description:
The app's navigation as data, drawn as one of 21 sidebars: pass the
screens once and pick a variant. Put it in AppShell's sidebar. For a
sidebar built by hand, use Sidebar, NavSection and NavItem instead.

items.name: site-header
items.title: SiteHeader
items.description: A website's top bar: the brand, the main links and one call to action. On a phone, the links fold into a menu.

items.name: site
items.title: Section, FeatureGrid, LogoCloud, Testimonials, Faq, CallToAction, SiteFooter, AuthLayout, AuthDivider
items.description: A band of a landing page: a heading and what's under it, at the page's width.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Something is loading. Inside a button, the button's own loading prop draws it.

items.name: table-tools
items.title: BulkActionBar, ColumnSettings, SavedViews, TransferList, TreeView
items.description: When rows are selected, what can be done to all of them at once, with how many and a way out.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description:
Rows of the same kind of thing: orders, customers, bookings. Numbers right-aligned, statuses as Badges.
Narrower than 32rem (a phone, a side panel), each row stacks into a card: its first cell as the
title, then each column's name and value, so nothing hides off to the right.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description:
Switches between views of the same thing, in seven looks. A marker slides
to the open tab and the content fades in; arrow keys move between tabs.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toaster
items.description: Where toasts appear: put one in the app's root layout. They stack, newest last, and pause while hovered.

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace, TraceStep, Plan, TaskList, ToolCall, Reasoning, Subagent, Sources, InlineCitation, Checkpoint
items.description: A list of steps, joined by a thin line down the icons.

items.name: upload
items.title: FileUpload, UploadItem, ImageUpload, AvatarUpload, FileGlyph
items.description: Drop files or pick them, in three sizes: a drop area, a one-line bar, or a button. Lists what was chosen.

items.name: workspace
items.title: NotificationCenter, AuditLog, PermissionMatrix, InviteMembers, UsageMeter, PlanSummary, SetupChecklist, SaveBar, ConfirmByTyping, ApprovalCard
items.description: The bell: how many are unread, and a list of what happened, grouped by Today and Earlier, with Mark all as read.
